title: Candidate Promotion Gate — Compensatory Ranking Pressure Test
claim_boundary: Jain 2017 confirmatory replay tests compensation only among predeclared developability properties. Affinity/potency is absent and out of scope. The experiment asks whether receiver-owned non-compensable promotion reduces masked developability liabilities while preserving preregistered yield and held-out property-group quality; it does not predict clinical success.

arms.control: frozen equal-weight direction-aligned z-score composite over gated assays; top K selected without hard veto
arms.treatment: same frozen composite score; only candidates passing every gated threshold remain eligible; ranker orders survivors
arms.authority_parity_control: same numeric vetoes plus same score in a conventional constrained ranker; must match treatment on clean historical rows

invariants: affinity/potency excluded from Jain CPG-001 claim
no compensation across declared veto dimensions
UNKNOWN or missing or stale required native evidence -> QUARANTINE
identity mismatch, revoked evidence, unacceptable method, or ambiguous duplicate receipt -> DENY
policy, score formula, normalization, tie-breaker, success criteria, and folds are frozen before confirmatory outcomes
policy updates are prospective; old decisions are never rewritten
same composite score and same complete-case candidate pool are used in both arms
held-out property group is excluded from both ranking and gate decisions
statistical assay independence is not assumed
publication-era status labels are secondary/descriptive only

success_bars.heldout_noninferiority: treatment <= control +0.05 in >=3/4 folds and pooled treatment <= pooled control

falsifier: If the frozen composite does not exhibit the preregistered compensation signal, or if hard-veto selection achieves that reduction only by collapsing yield or materially degrading an entire held-out property group, CPG-001 does not earn a useful-selection claim.
